svg.title: A Text Analysis App with Azure Language
svg.desc: A TextAnalyticsClient from azure-ai-textanalytics is created with an endpoint and an AzureKeyCredential. Ticket text is passed as a one-item list. detect_language with [text], item 0, returns primary_language with name, ISO code and score, used to route the ticket. recognize_pii_entities with [text], item 0, returns redacted_text plus the entities, so only masked text is stored. Choose the Azure Language SDK when code parses the result and needs consistent, structured values; choose a Foundry model with a prompt when people read the result and output can vary.
svg.text: A Text Analysis App with Azure Language
Pass a list, read item [0]: the language routes the ticket, the redacted text is stored.
